Author: Cursor Agent
Message:
feat(signing): Vault Transit BYOK, raw Ed25519, no 2.2.0 fallback

Preserve mycelium-a5-ed25519-v1 by importing the pinned identity
(wrapping key + transit/keys/.../import). Never generate a new
keypair under that name. Sign on-disk canonical bytes as Base64
with prehashed=false. Ceremony policy is update on sign, read on
keys; tokens are 10m and non-renewable. Cosign stays a different
plane. Schema 2.2.0 fails closed at that boundary.

Co-authored-by: rahshaun44-byte <rahshaun44-byte@users.noreply.github.com>

Author: Cursor Agent
Message:
feat(signing): one ceremony, three planes, no keyring search

Standardize hash → canonical manifest → detached Ed25519 → single
key_id pin → gate. Host A5 generator emits schema 2.2.0 with
signing.key_id; historical 2.1.0 still verifies. Mobile stays
hash-only; admission stays unsigned hash binding. CI refuses the
prod A5 private key. Wrong-plane key_id fail-closes without trying
other keys.
